oracle_input.question: Start with an empty stack, written bottom to top. Execute PUSH 4, PUSH 9, POP, PUSH 6, DUP, POP, ADD. DUP copies the top; ADD pops the top two and pushes their sum. POP discards its top but records that number. Return only JSON with final stack and popped numbers in POP order.

explanation: Explicit POPs remove nine then six; the final ADD combines four and six into ten.
